items.title: 68516_Gene Ramey oral history interview
items.q: I took his job away from him with George Corley's Royal Aces.

ctx.x: He was bass horn player in that jazz band. I took his job away from him with George Corley's Royal Aces. And he was a well-learned tuba player, you know. He played the sousaphone, he played double B flat, and I
